sections.heading: Indian Institute of Health Education & Research vs NIHER Patna for Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT): which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Indian Institute of Health Education & Research if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹2 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹90,250, in a private Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) setting at Patna.
